BREAKER-WARD CONTRACT OF FENSPIRE

Let it be entered beneath the ash-seal and read before the watch:

Fenspire stands in the Gloaming Reach, founded in 57 AS, and remains
a core location of the realm. Its garrisoned status shall not be
disputed, diminished, or spoken of as a temporary inconvenience. Its
garrison is 3,742, and those counted beneath its walls are charged
to vigilance, wall-duty, and the preservation of the living from
what rises in the fen.

ARTICLE I — OF THE THREAT

The Marsh Revenant is acknowledged by this contract as a siege-
breaker, defined by its ability to shatter fortified resistance. It
is a revenant of stagnant, hostile ground, and its presence turns
defense into desperation.

It appears as a corpse-like figure burdened with marsh-wet decay and
the grim solidity of a breaker of walls. It projects tireless,
impersonal hostility, advancing with the inevitability of the dead.

Any signer who calls it a beast, raider, or common corpse accepts
the consequences of that error. Such words have undone stronger
walls than these.

ARTICLE II — OF FENSPIRE

The parties recognize the silhouette of Fenspire: a stark spire
rising above the dim character of the Gloaming Reach. Its atmosphere
is shaped by permanent military occupation, and it projects
disciplined vigilance.

The garrison shall maintain watch upon approaches, foundations,
gates, and all ground where stagnant water may conceal hostile
movement. No watchman shall abandon a post merely because the marsh
is quiet. Quiet is not peace. Quiet is the Revenant listening.

ARTICLE III — DUTIES OF THE SIGNERS

The undersigned shall:

- report any sighting of the Marsh Revenant without embellishment
  or concealment;

- preserve written accounts of damage to walls, doors, towers, and
defensive works;
- deny the creature access to fortified resistance by whatever
lawful defense remains at hand;
- obey the appointed voice during an alarm, unless that voice
commands the opening of the gates to the Marsh Revenant;
- provide aid to the garrison of 3,742, without claiming that
numbers alone make Fenspire safe.
No signer shall pursue the Marsh Revenant into stagnant ground for
glory, proof, payment, or the relief of wounded pride. The dead do
not admire courage.

ARTICLE IV — BREACH AND PENALTY

If a signer abandons assigned duty, conceals a warning, or weakens a
defense, the breach shall be recorded against that signer’s mark and
possessions as the lawful authority determines. If the signer
survives long enough to answer.

This contract remains binding while Fenspire retains its garrisoned
status and while the Marsh Revenant remains a threat to its walls.
